verdict.rationale: Kong's Insomnia/Inso CLI supports running a full collection of tests with pass/fail exit codes (`inso run test`), CI integration via Git workflows, unlimited simultaneous test runs, and Postman collection import, matching the story closely. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of a full collection run producing a formatted pass/fail report, and no evidence of native Kong Gateway (vs Insomnia) test-suite tooling.
